title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.88
exact_target: Is there a finite nonabelian odd-order group whose conjugacy-class count is exactly one seventeenth of its order?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2597 (KOU-21.88). CC BY 4.0.

D. MacHale, Problem 21.88, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). This version records a negative answer; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
